name: Kagurazaka Mei
source:
Hobbies: Gaming
Skills: Gaming
Weakness: Studying

A first-year student and the accountant of the east tower's student council. A self-proclaimed gaming genius called "Arashi", she is the Japanese represetantive of the popular fighting game "Witch's Garden". Mei's magic skills and potential are pretty average, and she controls lightning magic.

A very honest girl who acts with her emotions first and thinks later. She is also part of the "gaming club" and has named the student council room "gaming club (temp)" to the point where she has already brought her television and one console in. Being a gamer, she loves snacks and is always shown eating umeboshi in the student council room.
